channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Second minister visits Yasukuni Shrine during its autumn festival
item.description: Liberal Democratic Party General Council chair Hiroshi Kajiyama also made a ritual cash offering on behalf of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.

item.title: Daiichi Life offers $4.4 billion to buy rest of Challenger
item.description: A deal would give the Japanese insurer control of Australia's largest provider of annuities in the nation's fast-growing retirement market.

item.title: Japan aims to soothe world traders’ fiscal anxiety with outreach in English
item.description: Foreign investors held 13% of Japanese Government Bonds at the end of June, up from about 8% in 2012.

item.title: Kioxia shares face headwinds from margin-buying gone wrong
item.description: Outstanding leveraged long positions in the stock was the largest as of Oct. 15 among all companies listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
